name: Get the email editor session (userHash)
description: Return the per-user values the email editor needs, including userHash, which set_campaign_html_content requires. The response also holds a sessionId and the account phone number; never log, repeat or store them.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. Found by the blind-agent evaluation, which flagged userHash as a blocker. Keys seen: id, userHash, sessionId, locale, permissions, features, plan, pricingVersion, phoneNumber.
